articles.title: Crypto industry cheers Senate Clarity Act markup date as market structure push resumes
articles.snippet: The bill's progress follows talks on jurisdiction, consumer/developer protections, and stablecoin rewards, with crypto firms backing a yield compromise.

articles.title: Senate Banking Committee plans to hold key market structure hearing on Thursday
articles.snippet: The Senate Banking Committee announced it would hold its markup hearing for the Clarity Act on March 14.

articles.title: Crypto exchanges pushed US lawmakers to bar provision on risky tokens: Report
articles.snippet: Three companies reportedly pressed US senators for changes to a crypto bill, removing language that would require them to offer trading on tokens “not readily susceptible to manipulation.”

articles.title: US Senator questions Mark Zuckerberg on Meta’s stablecoin plans
articles.snippet: Elizabeth Warren asked the Meta CEO to provide details on a stablecoin integration to the platform, a week after a small rollout to creators in Colombia and the Philippines.

articles.title: Banking Industry Says Clarity Act Stablecoin Proposal Would Enable 'Evasion'
articles.snippet: Senators had hoped the issue, which has plagued crypto legislation for months, had been put to bed with a proposed compromise last week.
